# WebSocket Protocol 🟡 BETA

The chat transport. One socket carries every chat frame; control frames
are distinguished by a `type` field.

## Handshake

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Path | `/ws` (bot from the query string) or `/ws/{bot}` | `botserver/src/main_module/server/run_axum_server.rs` |
| Reserved segments | `attendant` — the console stream lives at `/api/attendance/ws`, not under `/ws` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/handler.rs` |
| Unknown bot | `404` with `{"error": "bot_not_found", "message", "bot_name"}` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/handler.rs` |

Query parameters (`WsQuery` in `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/handler.rs`):

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `access_token` | suite/cloud token; when valid it determines the identity |
| `bot_name` | bot name or slug when the path does not carry it |
| `session_id` | session to resume; a fresh UUID is generated when absent or invalid |
| `user_id` | guest identity hint — never trusted for an authenticated session |

## `message_type` values

From `botlib/src/message_types.rs`:

| Value | Constant | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `EXTERNAL` | message from an external system |
| 1 | `USER` | user message — the default for an inbound chat frame |
| 2 | `BOT_RESPONSE` | bot answer, streamed as chunks |
| 3 | `CONTINUE` | keep processing |
| 4 | `SUGGESTION` | suggestion button |
| 5 | `CONTEXT_CHANGE` | context switch |
| 6 | `TOOL_EXEC` | run the tool directly — bypasses the LLM |
| 7 | `SYSTEM` | system notice |
| 8 | `SWITCHER_TOGGLE` | switcher UI toggle |
| 9 | `UI_ACTION` | UI action plan (`__ui_plan__`) |

## Chat frame (`BotResponse`)

Every chat message, in both directions, is this JSON object
(`botlib/src/models/messaging.rs`):

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `bot_id` | `String` | yes |
| `user_id` | `String` | yes |
| `session_id` | `String` | yes |
| `channel` | `String` | yes |
| `content` | `String` | yes |
| `message_type` | `MessageType` | yes |
| `stream_token` | `Option<String>` | no |
| `is_complete` | `bool` | yes |
| `suggestions` | `Vec<Suggestion>` | no |
| `switchers` | `Vec<Switcher>` | no |
| `context_name` | `Option<String>` | no |
| `context_length` | `usize` | yes |
| `context_max_length` | `usize` | yes |
| `reasoning` | `String` | no |

## Control frames (client → server)

| `type` | Sent by |
|---|---|
| `run_cancel` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs`, `botui/ui/suite/chat/chat-turn-state.js`, `botui/ui/suite/chat/modules/71_run_timeline.js` |
| `run_resume` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs`, `botui/ui/suite/chat/modules/71_run_timeline_frames.js` |
| `run_takeover` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs`, `botui/ui/suite/chat/modules/71_run_timeline.js` |

## Frames the server emits

| `type` | Emitted from |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/takeover.rs`, `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/stream/turn.rs` |
| `connected` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session.rs` |
| `gb.steer` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/stream/turn.rs` |
| `gb.steering_queued` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs` |
| `message_received` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs` |
| `rate_limited` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session.rs` |
| `run_cancelled` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs` |
| `run_resume_done` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/resume.rs` |
| `run_takeover_ack` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/takeover.rs` |

`CUSTOM` is an envelope: the interesting part is `data.name`.

| `data.name` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `gb.steer` | steering notice published on the run bus |
| `gb.takeover` | takeover state change (`payload.state`, `payload.surface`) |

## Delivery rules

| Rule | Evidence |
|---|---|
| A turn is acknowledged with `message_received`; the client clears its retry timer only on that frame | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/inbound.rs` |
| A message that arrives while a run is active is queued as steering and acknowledged with `gb.steering_queued` | same file |
| `run_cancel` cancels the thread and answers `run_cancelled` | same file |
| `run_resume` replays only frames after `last_seq` and finishes with `run_resume_done` | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/resume.rs` |
| `run_takeover` requires the session owner and answers `run_takeover_ack` (or a denial frame) | `botserver/src/core/bot/ws/session/takeover.rs` |

Frame bodies are built with `serde_json::json!` at each call site, so no
single Rust struct describes them; the tables above list the `type` values
the code actually emits. Fields not shown here are not part of a contract.
